name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Mass Driver Turret MDT-6 'Trebuchet'
description: A vehicle-mounted electromagnetic mass driver that accelerates 5 kg projectiles to hypersonic velocity, functioning as a modern artillery piece with no chemical propellant. The MDT-6 uses a 20-stage linear electromagnetic accelerator mounted on a tracked vehicle chassis, capable of hurling dense metal projectiles up to 15 kilometers with GPS-guided precision. The impact of a 5 kg tungsten slug at Mach 7 produces a crater equivalent to a 500 kg bomb without any explosive — pure kinetic energy transfer. Zheng-Dao developed the MDT-6 for long-range fire support, and its ability to deliver devastating strikes with no explosive signature makes it difficult for counterbattery systems to detect and return fire on.
specifications:
projectile mass: 5 kg tungsten
muzzle velocity: Mach 7 (approximately 2,400 m/s)
maximum range: 15 kilometers
accelerator stages: 20-stage linear electromagnetic
rate of fire: 1 round per 20 seconds
magazine: 12 rounds in autoloader
mount: Tracked vehicle chassis
weight: 18,000 kg complete system
power source: Onboard fusion generator
story_hooks: An unexplained crater in Tier 3 has been attributed to a gas explosion, but the impact pattern is consistent with a mass driver strike — someone used strategic artillery inside the city.
A Zheng-Dao MDT-6 was disabled during transit and the vehicle crew was found dead with no visible wounds — the weapon was not stolen, but the fire control software was accessed.

physical_description.visual_profile: A massive tracked artillery platform dominated by an extremely long, angular electromagnetic accelerator barrel extending forward like a lance. The sleek, purposeful design emphasizes raw kinetic force over aesthetics. The entire structure evokes a predatory mantis or siege engine reimagined through physics and mathematics.
physical_description.dimensions: Vehicle chassis: 8.2m long × 3.1m wide × 2.8m high. Accelerator barrel: 6.8m length protruding forward. Barrel diameter: 42cm at muzzle.
physical_description.weight_description: Monumentally heavy and earth-anchored—18 metric tons of pure kinetic potential. Feels immovable when stationary; the tracked base distributes crushing weight across contact points.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced carbon-composite chassis with steel internal frame. Accelerator barrel is segmented ceramic-polymer composite with embedded electromagnetic coils. Tracks are industrial-grade titanium-alloy links.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal with worn primer showing through contact points. Bare steel accent panels on accelerator stages where maintenance access is frequent. Fusion reactor housing has a brushed steel finish with faint heat discoloration around vents.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey primary with gunmetal steel accents. Faint orange heat-stress marks around power coupling ports. Zheng-Dao corporate red stripe running the length of the chassis.
physical_description.grip_texture: N/A—vehicle-mounted system. Control interfaces feature rubberized tactical panels and recessed toggle switches.
distinctive_features: Segmented accelerator barrel with visible electromagnetic coil housings at each of 20 stages, marked by thin ridges and cooling vent lines
Heavy counterbalance actuators beneath the chassis to manage recoil displacement
Fusion reactor housing prominent on starboard side, cylindrical and heavily shielded with hazard markings
Autoloader magazine carousel visible on port side—a rotating drum capable of holding 12 tungsten projectiles
Thermal dissipation fins running the length of the barrel, glowing faint amber during operation
GPS targeting module mounted atop chassis with reinforced sensor array
Weapon status indicator lights (amber, red) clustered near the commander's position
Deep scorch marks and impact scarring on the lower chassis from atmospheric reentry dust and electromagnetic discharge
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries corporate logo (stylized geometric triangle) stamped in 15cm height on both sides of chassis. Serial plate riveted to starboard accelerator housing. Warning placard in Mandarin, English, and technical symbology mounted below muzzle: 'HYPERSONIC KINETIC WEAPON—LETHAL RADIUS BEYOND VISUAL RANGE.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn and combat-tested. Accelerator barrel shows light oxidation and dust accumulation. Tracks bear mud and debris from recent deployment. Reactor vents glow with residual thermal energy. No cosmetic care applied—purely functional military equipment.
